# Captured Context7 responses

These are text results of `resolve-library-id` captured from `https://mcp.context7.com/mcp` on 2026-10-19 (anonymous, no API key).
Context7's ranking and version lists change over time, so tests parse these files instead of calling the service.

`resolve-react.txt` is one capture with the `/react/react` entry inserted exactly as returned by an earlier capture of the
same query the same day (the service returned it in one response and not the other).
